This script uses a lot of different chunks to visualize different genotyping results from different methods. Its really kinda long, before every chunk is a quick description of what im trying to show with the plots and some ideas and questions I was trying to answer with the visualization. Plots are saved inside Results/dataset_name/Graphics/...

After completing this script, move on to 07_Failed_Genotypes_Analysis.Rmd

## Settings, paths and basic setup
This chunks contain libraries, global settings, editable variables used by the whole .Rmd and paths for necessary input files.

```{r setup, results = "hide"}
suppressMessages({
  library(grid)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(knitr)
})

# Settings come from the params block in the YAML header, this turns them into usable variables
invisible(list2env(params, envir = environment()))
settings_used <- data.frame(setting = c("run_date", names(params)),
                            value = c(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
                                      vapply(params, function(setting_value) paste(setting_value, collapse = ", "), character(1))))
# Uploading shared functions
source("Code/R_scripts/asp_functions.R", local = TRUE)

plot_font <- "Times New Roman"
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font))

# Paths for genotype and graphics outputs
graphics_dir <- file.path("Results", dataset_name, "Graphics") 
genotypes_dir <- file.path("Results", dataset_name, "Genotypes_results")

# Shared function for building accurate settings based folder names
run_names <- build_run_names(input_type, use_anchors, anchor_length, threshold_type, error_rate, min_score_fraction, probe_type = probe_type)

asp_reads_path <- file.path(genotypes_dir, run_names$asp_run_name, "all_barcodes_asp_reads.tsv")
ref_path <- file.path("Data/Supporting_data/Reference_genotypes", paste0("genotypes_", dataset_name, ".tsv")) # Genotype references

# Imported shared data between all chunks, loaded and cleaned once in setup
ref <- read_tsv(ref_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(sample = sample_id, locus, genotype, method = "reference")
```



## Speed optimization analysis - basic bar plots 

These three plots show progress of speed optimization analysis from naive v1 to last v11 with all the updates. Plots both for small and big dataset and comparison of reads per second for the big data set.

```{r Speed_Optimization_Analysis, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6, out.width = "100%"}
# Shared editable variables and helper functions. This chunk always compares both data sets, small and big.
# Folders for timing logs and output paths
speed_logs_small <- "Results/small/Genotypes_results/old/Identified_ASP_genotypes"
speed_logs_big <- "Results/big/Genotypes_results/old/Identified_ASP_genotypes"
out_dir_speed_opt_small <- "Results/small/Graphics/Speed_Optimization_Analysis"
out_dir_speed_opt <- "Results/big/Graphics/Speed_Optimization_Analysis"
dir.create(out_dir_speed_opt_small, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(out_dir_speed_opt, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

locus_row_regex <- "^\\[locus \\d+/\\d+\\] (\\S+) \\((\\d+) reads" #[locus 3/33] BICF2G630340139, group 1 for loci, group 2 for reads

#labels
speed_label <- function(before, after) {
  ifelse(after <= before, sprintf("%.1fx faster", before / after), sprintf("%.1fx slower", after / before))
}

# Plot function for both dataset using total time and added arrows
plot_total_time_f <- function(totals, palette, from_bar, to_bar, title, show_minutes) {
  y_max <- max(totals$total_seconds)
  label_gap <- y_max * 0.08 # space between a bar and the start of its arrow
  x_inset <- 0.32 # keeps the arrows off the bars

  bars <- totals %>%
    mutate(label = if (show_minutes) sprintf("%.0fs\n(%.1f min)", total_seconds, total_seconds / 60) else sprintf("%.1fs", total_seconds))

  # Arrows spacing and positioning
  arrows <- tibble(x = from_bar + x_inset,
                   xend = to_bar - x_inset,
                   y = totals$total_seconds[from_bar] + label_gap,
                   yend = totals$total_seconds[to_bar] + label_gap,
                   label = speed_label(totals$total_seconds[from_bar], totals$total_seconds[to_bar])) %>%
    mutate(x_mid = (x + xend) / 2, 
           y_label = (y + yend) / 2 + y_max * 0.12)

  y_top <- max(arrows$y_label, arrows$y, totals$total_seconds + label_gap) * 1.15 

  # Plot
  ggplot(bars, aes(x = version, y = total_seconds, fill = version)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold", size = 4, colour = "#0b0b0b") +
    geom_curve(data = arrows, aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               curvature = -0.3, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#52514e",
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.16, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
    geom_label(data = arrows, aes(x = x_mid, y = y_label, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", colour = "#0b0b0b",
               fill = "#fcfcfb", linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06)), limits = c(0, y_top)) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = "\n* v1 is not a real speed comparison - does less work per read.",
         x = NULL,
         y = "Total pipeline time (seconds)") +
    theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#0b0b0b", margin = margin(b = 4)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#52514e"),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 14, r = 14, b = 8, l = 8),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#52514e"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#898781"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(colour = "#52514e"))
}

# Plot for small dataset
v1_naive_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v1_old_naive_genotyper/very_first_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v2_Qscores_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v2_quality_scoring_before_restructuring/original_fixed_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v3_Qscore_restructured_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v3_quality_scoring_restructured/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v4_parallel_4pwalign_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v4_quality_scoring_parallel_4pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v5_parallel_2pwalign_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v5_quality_scoring_parallel_2pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v6_final_anchored_small <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_small, "v11_3anchors_agreementTRUE_strand_check/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Total time needed for finishing the analysis
v1_total_small <- filter(v1_naive_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v2_total_small <- sum(filter(v2_Qscores_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds) # no total pipeline log, summing over the steps
v3_total_small <- filter(v3_Qscore_restructured_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v4_total_small <- filter(v4_parallel_4pwalign_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_total_small <- filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v6_total_small <- filter(v6_final_anchored_small, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_scoring_small <- sum(filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds) # again summed over loci
v6_scoring_small <- sum(filter(v6_final_anchored_small, grepl(locus_row_regex, step))$seconds)

# Bar colours in order
palette_small <- c(
  "First naive function (v1)\n(no QPhred scores)*" = "#72874E",
  "QPhred aware\n function (v2)" = "#AB5D26",
  "Restructured v2" = "#C3722A",
  "Restructured v2 +\n parallel (7 cores)" = "#E6DAB9",
  "Direction-aware\n2x pairwiseAlignment" = "#E1C473",
  "Final: anchors +\nposition & strand checks" = "#2C5724")

totals_small <- tibble(version = factor(names(palette_small), levels = names(palette_small)),
                       total_seconds = c(v1_total_small, v2_total_small, v3_total_small, v4_total_small, v5_total_small, v6_total_small))

# arrows from 2 to 3 and 3 to 4 and so on.
plot_total_time_small <- plot_total_time_f(totals_small, palette_small, from_bar = c(2, 3, 5), to_bar = c(3, 4, 6),
                                           title = "Small dataset: total pipeline runtime across every version", show_minutes = FALSE)
print(plot_total_time_small)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt_small, "small_dataset_total.png"), plot_total_time_small, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt_small, "small_dataset_total.pdf"), plot_total_time_small, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

kable(transmute(totals_small, version = gsub("\n", " ", version), seconds = round(total_seconds, 1),
                faster_than_v2 = round(v2_total_small / total_seconds, 2)))

# Plot for the big dataset
v1_naive_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v1_old_naive_genotyper/very_first_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v2_Qscores_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v2_quality_scoring_before_restructuring/original_fixed_timing_log.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v4_parallel_4pwalign_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v4_quality_scoring_parallel_4pwalign/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v5_parallel_2pwalign_7cores_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v5_quality_scoring_parallel_2pwalign_7cores/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
v6_final_big <- read_tsv(file.path(speed_logs_big, "v11_3anchors_agreementTRUE_strand_check/restructured_timing_log_parallel.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# these five names are used by the spiral chunk
v1_naive_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v1_naive_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v2_Qscores_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v4_parallel_4pwalign_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v5_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v5_parallel_2pwalign_7cores_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds
v6_pipeline_total_big <- filter(v6_final_big, step == "TOTAL PIPELINE")$seconds

# number of reads in the big dataset
n_reads_total_big <- sum(as.integer(sub(paste0(locus_row_regex, ".*"), "\\2", grep(locus_row_regex, v4_parallel_4pwalign_big$step, value = TRUE))))

palette_big <- c(
  "First naive function (v1)\n(no QPhred scores)*" = "#72874E",
  "QPhred aware\n function (v2)" = "#AB5D26",
  "Restructured v2 +\n parallel (3 cores)" = "#E6DAB9",
  "Direction-aware\n2x pairwiseAlignment (7 cores)" = "#E1C473",
  "Final: anchors +\nposition & strand checks" = "#2C5724")

totals_big <- tibble(version = factor(names(palette_big), levels = names(palette_big)),
                     total_seconds = c(v1_naive_pipeline_total_big, v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big, v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big,
                                       v5_pipeline_total_big, v6_pipeline_total_big)) %>%
  mutate(reads_per_sec = n_reads_total_big / total_seconds)

# arrows similar as before
plot_total_time_big <- plot_total_time_f(totals_big, palette_big, from_bar = c(2, 3, 4), to_bar = c(3, 4, 5),
                                         title = sprintf("Big dataset (%s reads): total pipeline time", format(n_reads_total_big, big.mark = ",")),
                                         show_minutes = TRUE)
print(plot_total_time_big)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_total_pipeline.png"), plot_total_time_big, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_total_pipeline.pdf"), plot_total_time_big, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

# reads processed per second
plot_reads_per_second_big <- ggplot(totals_big, aes(x = version, y = reads_per_sec, fill = version)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5, colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f reads/sec", reads_per_sec)), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_big, guide = "none") +
  expand_limits(y = max(totals_big$reads_per_sec) * 1.15) +
  labs(title = "Big dataset: throughput (reads processed per second)",
       subtitle = "* v1's higher throughput reflects doing less per read, not a faster algorithm - see total-time chart",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Reads / second") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = plot_font, base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(plot_reads_per_second_big)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_throughput.png"), plot_reads_per_second_big, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_speed_opt, "bigdataset_throughput.pdf"), plot_reads_per_second_big, width = 12, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)

# time of each part of the final run and banners
phase_df_big <- v6_final_big %>%
  filter(grepl("^Part [123] total", step)) %>%
  mutate(phase = substr(step, 1, 6), pct = 100 * seconds / v6_pipeline_total_big)

kable(transmute(totals_big, version = gsub("\n", " ", version), seconds = round(total_seconds), minutes = round(total_seconds / 60, 1),
                reads_per_sec = round(reads_per_sec), faster_than_v2 = round(v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big / total_seconds, 1)))

cat(sprintf("  v2 -> v4: %s | v5 -> final: %s | v2 -> final: %s\n",
            speed_label(v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big, v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big),
            speed_label(v5_pipeline_total_big, v6_pipeline_total_big),
            speed_label(v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big, v6_pipeline_total_big)))
cat(sprintf("  Phase breakdown (final run): %s\n",
            paste(sprintf("%s = %.1fs (%.1f%%)", phase_df_big$phase, phase_df_big$seconds, phase_df_big$pct), collapse = ", ")))
cat(" * v1 is not an apples-to-apples speed comparison - see plot subtitles.\n")
```

## Du Bois plots for speed optimization analysis and SNP read base quality 
This chunk contains plots for SNP read base qaulity and speed optimization using Du Bois data visualization as refernce for the plot with changed colours. Code for this was built by Pat Schloss (Riffomonas), I just used my data (https://riffomonas.org/code_club/2025-02-17-panel-27).

```{r Du_Bois_Plots_for_Speed_Optimization_Analysis_and_SNP_Quality, results = "asis", fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 7, out.width = "55%"}
# Du Bois plate 27 style pies: quality of the read base on the SNP. First pie plot showing SNP read base quality of the correctly and wrongly called reads in HM pairs. Second plot shows SNP read base quality of the rarer allele in reads from HM (error or noise) and HT (actual real second allele just lower freq).

# Settings
out_dir_Dubois <- file.path(graphics_dir, "Dubois_plots")
dir.create(out_dir_Dubois, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pie_out_right_wrong <- file.path(out_dir_Dubois, sprintf("%sdataset_dubois_snp_quality_pie.png", dataset_name))
pie_out_rare_allele <- file.path(out_dir_Dubois, sprintf("%sdataset_dubois_minority_allele_quality_pie.png", dataset_name))

# Quality groups, q4 is best
pie_categories <- c("q4", "q3", "q2", "q1")
pie_fills <- c(q4 = "#A4B591FF", q3 = "#E1C473FF", q2 = "#C3722AFF", q1 = "#A12A19FF")
pie_legend <- tribble(
  ~x_dot, ~x_label, ~y, ~category, ~label,
  -0.90, -0.84, 0.12, "q4", "Q30 AND OVER",
  -0.90, -0.84, -0.12, "q3", "Q20 TO Q29",
   0.90, 0.84, 0.12, "q2", "Q10 TO Q19",
   0.90, 0.84, -0.12, "q1", "UNDER Q10"
) #593722FF, #834D24FF, #AB5D26FF, #C3722AFF, #E1C473FF, #E6DAB9FF, #A4B591FF, #55804DFF, #416C39FF, #2C5724FF

# Data preparation
pie_reference <- ref %>% 
  filter(!is.na(genotype)) %>%
  transmute(barcode = sample,
            locus,
            ref_allele = substr(genotype, 1, 1), #separates genotype
            zygosity = ifelse(substr(genotype, 1, 1) == substr(genotype, 2, 2), "hom", "het")) # labels for genotypes

pie_reads <- read_tsv(asp_reads_path, col_select = c(barcode, locus, called_allele, snp_position_quality),
                      col_types = cols(barcode = "c", locus = "c", called_allele = "c", snp_position_quality = "d")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(called_allele)) %>% # counted reads only
  inner_join(pie_reference, by = c("barcode", "locus")) %>% # pairs with a ref genotype
  mutate(category = as.character(cut(snp_position_quality, c(-Inf, 9, 19, 29, Inf), #puts each one in a quality group
                                     labels = c("q1", "q2", "q3", "q4"))))

# The drawing function (same layout for both pies)
pie_draw <- function(reads, top_label, bottom_label, title, caption) { # It takes reads for one pie chart already labeled with top or bottom
  counts <- reads %>%
    count(half, category) %>% # Counts reads per half and quality category
    complete(half = c("top", "bottom"), category = pie_categories, fill = list(n = 0)) %>% # Adds missing combinations
    group_by(half) %>%
    mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n), half_n = sum(n)) %>% # Creates %
    ungroup()
print(kable(counts, digits = 1))

  slices <- counts %>%
    select(half, category, percent) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(half = c("top", "bottom"), category = "blank", percent = 60)) %>% # Creates two invisible blank slices
    mutate(slice = factor(paste(half, category, sep = "_"), levels = c("top_blank", paste0("top_", rev(pie_categories)),
                                                                       "bottom_blank", paste0("bottom_", rev(pie_categories))))) %>% 
    arrange(slice) %>%
    mutate(theta = 2 * pi * percent / sum(percent), # Eeach slice angle in radians
           final_theta = cumsum(theta) - first(theta) / 2, # Turns the pie back by half
           initial_theta = lag(final_theta, default = 0)) %>%
    filter(category != "blank", percent > 0) # Removes blanks

  # The outline of each slice: center, then along the arc, back to the center
  wedges <- slices %>%
      mutate(points = Map(function(from, to) {
      angles <- seq(from, to, length.out = 200) # Gives the function a starting and ending angle and 200 in between for a smooth arc
      tibble(x = c(0, cos(angles), 0), y = c(0, sin(angles), 0))
    }, initial_theta, final_theta)) %>%
    unnest(points)

  labels <- slices %>%
    mutate(mid = (initial_theta + final_theta) / 2,
           radius = ifelse(percent >= 10, 0.62, 0.86), # for small slices label is further out
           size = ifelse(percent >= 10, 11, 8),
           x = radius * cos(mid),
           y = radius * sin(mid),
           text = sprintf("%.0f%%", percent))

  n_top <- counts$half_n[counts$half == "top"][1]
  n_bottom <- counts$half_n[counts$half == "bottom"][1]

  ggplot(wedges, aes(x, y, group = slice, fill = category)) +
    geom_polygon(show.legend = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_text(data = labels, aes(x, y, label = text, size = size / .pt), inherit.aes = FALSE, family = plot_font) +
    geom_point(data = pie_legend, aes(x_dot, y, fill = category), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               shape = 21, size = 7, stroke = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = pie_legend, aes(x_label, y, label = label, hjust = ifelse(x_label < 0, 0, 1)), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              family = plot_font, size = 6.5 / .pt) +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = c(1.1, -1.1), family = plot_font, size = 8 / .pt,
             label = c(sprintf(top_label, format(n_top, big.mark = ",")),
                       sprintf(bottom_label, format(n_bottom, big.mark = ",")))) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pie_fills) +
    scale_size_identity() +
    labs(title = title, caption = caption, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20, b = 35)),
          plot.caption = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 6, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 30)),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
          plot.margin = margin(b = 30, l = 80, r = 80))
}


# 1. Pie plot for right vs wrong reads in HM pairs
pie_right_wrong_reads <- pie_reads %>%
  filter(zygosity == "hom", !is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(called_allele == ref_allele, "top", "bottom"))

pie_fig_right_wrong <- pie_draw(
  pie_right_wrong_reads,
  top_label = "CORRECTLY CALLED READS (%s).",
  bottom_label = "WRONGLY CALLED READS (%s).",
  title = "READ BASE QUALITY ON THE SNP.",
  caption = sprintf("%s DATASET; READS FROM SAMPLE-LOCUS PAIRS THAT ARE HOMOZYGOUS IN THE REFERENCE.", toupper(dataset_name)))

print(pie_fig_right_wrong)
ggsave(pie_out_right_wrong, pie_fig_right_wrong, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", pie_out_right_wrong), pie_fig_right_wrong, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)

# 2. Pie plot, reads of the rarer allele, HM (miscalls or noise) vs HT pairs
pie_rare_allele_reads <- pie_reads %>%
  add_count(barcode, locus, called_allele, name = "allele_n") %>%
  group_by(barcode, locus) %>%
  filter(called_allele != called_allele[which.max(allele_n)]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(category)) %>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(zygosity == "hom", "top", "bottom"))

pie_fig_rare_allele <- pie_draw(
  pie_rare_allele_reads,
  top_label = "RARER ALLELE IN HOMOZYGOTES: ERRORS (%s READS).",
  bottom_label = "RARER ALLELE IN HETEROZYGOTES: REAL SECOND ALLELE (%s READS).",
  title = "THE RARER ALLELE READ BASE\nQUALITY ON THE SNP.",
  caption = sprintf("%s DATASET; RARER ALLELE = THE ALLELE FEWER READS CALL IN THAT SAMPLE AND LOCUS.", toupper(dataset_name)))

print(pie_fig_rare_allele)
ggsave(pie_out_rare_allele, pie_fig_rare_allele, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(sub("\\.png$", ".pdf", pie_out_rare_allele), pie_fig_rare_allele, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)

# 3. Plot,Du Bois spiral (plate 25 style) for the big-dataset speed optimization. Each band one total pipeline time, lentgh proportional
spi_out_dir <- "Results/big/Graphics/Dubois_plots"
dir.create(spi_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# total pipeline time per version in seconds
stopifnot(exists("v1_naive_pipeline_total_big"), exists("v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big"),
          exists("v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big"), exists("v5_pipeline_total_big"),
          exists("v6_pipeline_total_big"))

spi_timings <- tribble(
  ~version, ~seconds,
  "NAIVE, NOT QUALITY AWARE (V1)*", v1_naive_pipeline_total_big,
  "QUALITY-AWARE (V2)", v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big,
  "RESTRUCTURED - 3 CORES (V4)", v4_parallel_4pwalign_pipeline_total_big,
  "DIRECTION-AWARE - 7 CORES (V5)", v5_pipeline_total_big,
  "FINAL - 5 CORES (V11)", v6_pipeline_total_big) %>%
  arrange(seconds) 

# centre number: quality-aware V2 time/final time (V1 not counted)
spi_speedup <- v2_Qscores_pipeline_total_big / v6_pipeline_total_big

spi_fills <- setNames(c("#2C5724FF", "#72874EFF", "#E6DAB9FF", "#E1C473FF", "#AB5D26FF"), spi_timings$version)
 #593722FF, #834D24FF, #AB5D26FF, #C3722AFF, #E1C473FF, #E6DAB9FF, #A4B591FF, #55804DFF, #416C39FF, #2C5724FF

spi_start_radius <- 15
spi_end_radius <- 9
spi_thickness <- 0.6
spi_min_length <- 0.35 # the smallest band would be almost invisible, minimum lentgth

# One row per version, position and label
spi_bands <- spi_timings %>%
  mutate(fraction = seconds / max(seconds), # the slowest version = 1 = the whole spiral
         offset = spi_thickness * (row_number() - 1), # each band sits one thickness further in
         label_y = spi_start_radius - offset - spi_thickness / 2, 
         time_label = case_when(seconds >= 3600 ~ sprintf("%.1f HOURS", seconds / 3600),
                                seconds >= 60 ~ sprintf("%.1f MIN", seconds / 60),
                                TRUE ~ sprintf("%.0f SEC", seconds)),
         version = factor(version, levels = version))

# Spiral bands as polygons. Points along one spiral line, from the top (angle 9*pi/2) round to the lower left (angle 3*pi/4), with length = the distance travelled along the line so far
spi_spiral_line <- function(from_radius, to_radius) {
  radius <- seq(from_radius, to_radius, length.out = 2000)
  angle <- seq(9 * pi / 2, 3 * pi / 4, length.out = 2000)
  x <- radius * cos(angle)
  y <- radius * sin(angle)
  tibble(x = x, y = y, length = cumsum(c(0, sqrt(diff(x)^2 + diff(y)^2))))
}

# the full length of the outer edge of thevinnermost band (100 %)
spi_full_length <- with(tail(spi_bands, 1),
                        max(spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset, spi_end_radius - offset)$length))

# each band = its outer edge, cut to its share of the full length, then back along its inner edge
spi_polygons <- spi_bands %>%
  group_by(version) %>%
  reframe({
    outer <- spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset, spi_end_radius - offset)
    inner <- spi_spiral_line(spi_start_radius - offset - spi_thickness, spi_end_radius - offset - spi_thickness)
    keep <- outer$length <= max(fraction * spi_full_length, spi_min_length)
    tibble(x = c(outer$x[keep], rev(inner$x[keep])),
           y = c(outer$y[keep], rev(inner$y[keep])))
  })

# Plot
spi_fig <- ggplot(spi_polygons, aes(x, y, group = version, fill = version)) +
  geom_polygon(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = spi_bands, aes(x = -0.5, y = label_y, label = time_label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = plot_font, size = 6.5 / .pt, hjust = 1) +
  geom_text(data = spi_bands, aes(x = -9.2, y = label_y, label = version), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = plot_font, size = 6 / .pt, hjust = 1) +
  annotate("segment", x = -9, xend = -5.2, y = spi_bands$label_y, yend = spi_bands$label_y, linewidth = 0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.6, label = sprintf("%.0fx", spi_speedup), family = plot_font, size = 25 / .pt) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -2.0, label = "FASTER", family = plot_font, size = 9 / .pt) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spi_fills) +
  labs(title = "TOTAL PIPELINE TIME OF THE ASP GENOTYPER\nON THE BIG DATASET, BY VERSION.",
       caption = "* THE NAIVE VERSION DOES LESS WORK PER READ; NOT A DIRECT COMPARISON.\nCENTRE: QUALITY-AWARE (V2) TIME / FINAL TIME.",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.title = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20, b = 40)),
        plot.caption.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(family = plot_font, size = 6, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 30)),
        plot.margin = margin(b = 40, l = 130, r = 30))

print(spi_fig)
ggsave(file.path(spi_out_dir, "spiral_figure.png"), spi_fig, width = 6.5, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(spi_out_dir, "spiral_figure.pdf"), spi_fig, width = 6.5, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
```
